learning_objective: 🎯 Travel across India through sound and discover the amazing variety of folk and classical music from different states!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: India is a huge country, and every state has its own unique style of music! From the snowy mountains to the sunny beaches, the songs, languages, and instruments change wherever you go.
Folk music is created by everyday people to celebrate village life. There are special folk songs for planting crops, celebrating festivals, or just dancing with friends around a fire.
India has two main classical music styles. Hindustani music is famous in North India, while Carnatic music is famous in the South. Both are beautiful and require years of practice to master!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Family Music Detective
fun_activity.instructions: Ask your parents or grandparents about a folk song from their home state or village. Ask them to teach you one line, and find out what instrument is usually played with it!

quick_recap: ⭐ Every region in India has its own special music, showing our country's rich diversity.
⭐ Folk music tells stories about everyday life, nature, and harvest festivals.
⭐ Hindustani classical music belongs to North India.
⭐ Carnatic classical music belongs to South India.
